authority: This contract governs candidate extraction and evaluation; it does not publish Engineering Statements.

input.holdout_policy: The development builder must never read acceptance_holdout, acceptance_holdout_reserve or blind_test content.
input.input_scope_policy: Stage 12 consumes the frozen representative_page_baseline Evidence slice; it does not create a representative chapter or expand upstream Evidence. Representative-chapter graph expansion belongs to the later candidate-graph stage.

architecture.provider_boundary: The production extraction provider is LLM Candidate Extraction. The LLM returns one or more independently retrievable statement texts per Evidence, bounded statement type, coarse relation, source-grounded entity wording with roles, true condition wording and applicability wording only. A statement is split when its proposition independently enters the graph, retrieval and answer support; shared scope, ordering and causal context must remain source-grounded. Deterministic code derives quantity, unit, comparison, negation, modality and relation direction from the returned statement text; it supplies fixed protocol constants and candidate entity class. Provider output is parsed strictly and then bound to canonical Evidence; it is never formal knowledge.
architecture.fixture_policy: Fixture is test/offline-only and cannot satisfy the formal Stage 12 extraction or quality gate.
architecture.unknown_applicability_policy: known = exact wording is present in the statement and Evidence; temporal/lifecycle/activity scope is distinct from a true antecedent condition; unknown is not not_applicable; absent values are omitted or marked unknown

runtime.per_evidence_cache: var/model_runs/stage12/evidence; stores only fully validated structured candidates keyed by Evidence, profile, split, provider metadata, provider configuration, statement Contract, candidate schema, prompt, response schema and semantic source fingerprints; raw model responses are never persisted
runtime.cache_revalidation: Cache hits still run deterministic validation. Cache key includes Evidence, Contract, Prompt and provider configuration fingerprints.
runtime.stale_cache_pruning: scripts/build_stage12_candidates.py retains only current Development Evidence cache keys and removes stale or invalid JSON entries; changed Prompt, Schema or semantic source fingerprints require fresh real-provider extraction and are never re-keyed
runtime.run_record_pruning: Only the latest completed Stage 12 batch record is retained under var/model_runs/stage12/batches
runtime.failure_summary: data/stage12/stage12_real_llm_failure_summary.json; one current overwritten summary containing bounded transport, schema and semantic attempt events

evaluation.legacy_metric_policy: statement_semantic_correctness is retained as historical exact Gold agreement and must not be interpreted as standalone semantic correctness; unmatched Gold rows are excluded from matched_field_accuracy.
evaluation.disagreement_policy: Evaluator reports differences. gold_error, evaluator_error and acceptable_semantic_equivalence require explicit human adjudication and are never inferred solely from Candidate != Gold.
evaluation.stop_tuning_rule: A Development mismatch permits Prompt or production semantic changes only when it demonstrates a generalizable language or engineering rule that survives synthetic counterexamples. Evidence-supported, non-critical granularity disagreements enter adjudication and do not trigger sample-specific tuning.
evaluation.promotion: No candidate is promoted by evaluation; Stage 13 review and later Release stages own approval.

development_quality_gate.threshold_basis: Conservative engineering minimums for safety, coverage and critical matched fields; not fitted to the current Development scores. Non-critical granularity fields remain observable and require adjudication rather than automatic failure.

evaluation.pipeline_ready_policy: PRODUCTION_LLM_PIPELINE_READY reports technical operability only: provider contract, real batch execution, schema/runtime validation, Evidence lineage, current cache and failure isolation. It is independent of Development quality, Robustness quality and Reserve acceptance.
evaluation.holdout_final_gate_policy: The exposed historical Holdout remains an observation and lineage check; it cannot satisfy or fail current final acceptance. Final acceptance uses only an independently prepared Reserve result.
